systems.owner: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, budgeted through its planning directorate (per the 2019 ADEA peer review the article cites)
systems.tiers: collects enrolment, teacher numbers and educational facilities; teachers and district officials in Mutoko say most rural schools, and some district offices, lack the devices or connectivity to contribute data in real time

note: The EMIS is described only as collecting enrolment, teacher and facility data, with no per-learner record that schools add to, so it is classed census and gives no fact; the article is undated (year 2025 from the row) and its resourcing findings are the 2019 peer review's.
